changelog: Wave 1.1 hotfix (incident df7a7ff8 follow-up) — server-only. Closes the residual 401 path missed in Wave 1: the public GET /api/agent/version handler now applies the same agent_releases gate as the heartbeat-ack path, so agents polling via updater.CheckForUpdate stop being told an update is available when none is publishable. Also corrects scripts/cleanup-401-failure-suppression.sql (updated_at → completed_at; the prior column name does not exist on this schema).
